title: HEAT Sentinel reticle index
description: `reticles/index.json`: every shipped reticle in one file, so the app reads one document instead of walking a directory it may be reading out of an installer's resource folder. GENERATED, never hand-edited — `py scripts/build_reticle_index.py` writes it from the per-folder manifests, and `--check` fails CI when it is stale. Same manifest shape as `sentinel-repo/public-catalog/catalog.json`: a version, a generation time, counts, and a hash per file.

generated.description: When the generator last ran, RFC 3339 in UTC. `null` in a checked-in empty index that no generator run has touched.

items.description: One manifest, plus what the generator worked out: which folder it is in, which kind its file turned out to be, and a hash per shipped file so an update can be told from a re-upload.

dir.description: Folder name under `reticles/`, which is also the id.

files.description: Every file the folder ships, by name relative to it.
